summary: This week, bring GitHub Enterprise Server repositories into the Copilot app and see which agent sessions need you first in VS Code. You can also try two new models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Gemini 4 Carbon.
takeaways: GitHub Copilot in VS Code (1.146 release) Let an agent run model comparisons for you.
GitHub Copilot Claude Fable 5.2 is available to Copilot Pro+, Max, Business, and Enterprise users.
With Compare Models enabled, turn on the agent tools in settings, and agents can find available models, launch comparisons, and read the results to summarize findings.
